text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a small runtime tweak that requires temporarily routing Dedicated customers to model v1.8 (pinned) while we validate the new kernel path. Change window Wed 2026-04-01 02:00-03:00 UTC. Ping @oncall. Thoughts?

aj: Which Dedicated pool(s) exactly? Need to update autoscaler config if we pin.

maria: dedicated-gpux-2 and dedicated-gpux-3. Quick config snippet I'm proposing to apply:
```yaml
deployment:
  model_pin: "model-v1.8"
  allow_fallback: false
  canary: 5%
```

ryan: +1 for pin but set `allow_fallback: true` for first 30m to avoid hard failures. Also add metric alert on `generation_error_rate > 1%`.

sophie: Devex note: SDK 2.3.0 changed model-selection defaults — if we pin at runtime, older SDKs that request `auto` may still get routed unexpectedly. We should add a compatibility callout in the release notes and update quickstarts.

lucas: Ops: I can schedule the deploy-bot job. Recommend rolling canary across 3 zones then full by 15 minutes if no regression.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: deploy/runtime-pin-1769004321
ETA: 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z
Canary: dedicated-gpux-2 (5%) -> dedicated-gpux-3 (5%) -> roll

maria: If any spike, plan is immediate rollback to "model-v1.9" and disable routing changes. Oncall will own rollback.

carol: Oncall here — I'll be on shift. I'll add a quick runbook to the incidents page and subscribe alerts.

sophie: Also prepping SDK callout: 
- Add note in changelog: "pinning behavior for dedicated pools"
- Add snippet:
```python
# if you rely on auto routing, update:
client.generate(model="model-v1.9")
```

aj: One more: add a test that replays busy-prefix workloads against v1.8 to verify latency P50/P95.

maria: Thanks. Action items: lucas will create deploy job (done), carol oncall, aj tests, sophie SDK note. We'll do 02:00 UTC window. I'll post postmortem if anything breaks :grimacing:.

deploy-bot: deploy/runtime-pin-1769004321 started canary on dedicated-gpux-2

ryan: Observability: I'll watch regen latency and error rate. Tagging @infra for kernel selection logs.

deploy-bot: Canary passed. Rolling to remaining hosts.

maria: Closing thread — post-deploy checklist will be updated in #eng-releases. :white_check_mark:
